description: This Java source file defines the ProductAvailability entity class for a shopping platform, including fields for product details such as quantity, availability date, shipping options, regional information, and pricing. It is part of the core business model layer, mapping to a database table with JPA annotations.

classes.name: ProductAvailability
classes.description: Entity class representing product availability details, including inventory and regional data, with relationships to Product and ProductPrice entities.

methods.name: defaultPrice
methods.description: Returns the default price from the set of associated ProductPrice objects, or a new ProductPrice if none is default.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: getProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Returns a cloned date object representing the date when the product is available.

methods.name: setProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the availability date, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region associated with this availability record.

methods.name: setRegion
methods.description: Sets the region associated with this availability record.

methods.name: getRegionVariant
methods.description: Returns the regional variant information.

methods.name: setRegionVariant
methods.description: Sets the regional variant information.

methods.name: getProductStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the product is active or not.

methods.name: setProductStatus
methods.description: Sets the product active status.

methods.name: getProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Returns whether free shipping is always available for the product.

methods.name: setProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Sets the free shipping status.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this availability record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the associated Product object.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product object.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Returns the set of associated ProductPrice objects.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the collection of ProductPrice objects.
